placeholders.name: GAME_NAME
placeholders.description: Internal project name, PascalCase, no spaces. The .app, the Xcode project and the AppSigning folder use it.
placeholders.howToGet: Pick it with the producer. It never changes after the first build.

placeholders.name: DISPLAY_NAME
placeholders.description: The name under the icon in the store build.

placeholders.name: DISPLAY_NAME_INHOUSE
placeholders.description: The name under the icon in the in-house build.
placeholders.howToGet: Usually the display name plus " Inhouse".

placeholders.name: CODE_NAME
placeholders.description: Lowercase code name with dashes. Repository and package name.

placeholders.name: SHORT_CODE
placeholders.description: Two or three letter short code.

placeholders.name: BUNDLE_ID
placeholders.howToGet: The producer, from the store account the game ships under.

placeholders.name: BUNDLE_ID_INHOUSE
placeholders.howToGet: Usually the store bundle id plus ".inhouse". It needs an enterprise profile in AppSigning.

placeholders.name: STORE_ACCOUNT
placeholders.description: Which Apple store account publishes the game. It fills APPLE_TEAM_ID and APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERT, so the two can't disagree. The in-house build stays on Tactile's enterprise account.
placeholders.howToGet: The producer: which company publishes the game. One of tactile-aps (Tactile Games ApS), promineo (Grupo Promineo), tactile-uk (Tactile Games Limited).

placeholders.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
placeholders.description: Apple developer team id of the store account: ios.teamId, for local iOS builds. Filled from STORE_ACCOUNT.

placeholders.name: APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERT
placeholders.description: The store account's iOS distribution certificate, as its App Store and ad hoc profiles name it: Build/Pipeline/values/ios/store/signing.yml. Filled from STORE_ACCOUNT.

placeholders.name: APPSIGNING_NAME
placeholders.description: The game's folder under app-signing ProvisioningProfiles/, with appstore, appstore_adhoc and inhouse .mobileprovision. Build/Pipeline/values/ios/xcode.yml APPSIGNING_GAME_NAME.
placeholders.howToGet: The Build Server owners add the game to the app-signing repo (games_config and ProvisioningProfiles/<name>/). Usually the same as GAME_NAME.

placeholders.name: BUILD_SERVER_PROJECT
placeholders.description: The game's project name on the Build Server, PascalCase. No file holds it: the Build Server reads it from its own project list.
placeholders.howToGet: A Build Server owner creates the project (the build-server tools cannot). Usually the same as GAME_NAME. Build/build_config.json leaves the store orgs (apple_appstore_org, google_playstore_org) empty on purpose: only automated store upload reads them, and an empty org fails the upload instead of sending it to the wrong account. Ask the Build Server owner for the account's org ids when upload is wanted.
